legos.why: PATTERN A. The prompt was written with dots in it; a prompt with a hole cannot be read out (L32 'absolutely no gapped LEGOs'; L22 'a label containing a gap … is a no-go'). Without the dots it is a complete phrase, and the rows already say it that way. Text only: the LEGO and its bare build row. POV pass: 'میں ہوں گا' is complete Urdu. Precedent: the rows of this basket.

legos.why: PATTERN B. The gap cannot simply close: this prompt is not sayable without a verb. L22: 'a bound element that cannot stand alone grows to the verb IN ITS OWN SEED'; L2: 'when one side can't be broken down, the other side follows and grows as well'. Both sides grow to the seed's own word. POV pass: Urdu 'کیا میں … سکتا ہوں' cannot be said without its verb. Precedent: eng_for_hin S0119L01 'can I ask' and eng_for_ben S0119L02 'can I ask', same seed. 'to ask' was taught at seed 30. Two rows said 'can I leave' and one row was a twin of another; those three are rewritten around 'can I ask'.
